column1: # All 36 splits are the UniMorph swc generator making a systematic
# error the kaikki (Wiktionary) table gets right: it omits the
# ku-retention monosyllabic verbs (and -enda) keep under the primary
# TAM markers (tunakufa, tunakwenda), applies it to disyllabic vowel
# stems that do not take it (kuimba, kukwepa, anaoa), drops the 2pl
# m- -> mw- glide before a vowel stem (mwone, muumbe), and now and
# then drops the subject concord outright (kwepe for tukwepe). In
# every case the engine follows kaikki (resolution o2).
